problem.h: The trip ends, and the memories go in a drawer
p: Tickets, receipts and a camera roll of 400 photos. Somehow it never becomes the travel journal you meant to make.
Pages of plain writing don’t capture the feeling of the place.

approach.h: One little picture for every place
p: Each sticker is a watercolour-style illustration of a city or country, with its name written across the top. Add one to your journal for each place you visit, and your pages start to look like a collection.
They work as a wish list too. Stick the places you dream of on a map or a vision board.

offer.p: Detailed, colourful illustrations of famous landmarks.

faq: Fifty cities and countries, including Paris, Rome, London, New York, Tokyo, Venice, Amsterdam, Singapore and more. Zoom into the full pack photo to see them all.
Can I put them on a suitcase?
Yes, they’re great on suitcases, laptops and notebooks as well as journal pages.
Would they suit a child’s travel journal?
Yes. They go well with My Adventure Travel Journal for young explorers.
Each sticker is a different place.
What if I’m not happy with them?
You buy through Amazon, so Amazon’s usual returns process applies. You can also email me at hello@mazomoon.com and I’ll do what I can to help.

close.p: Start your collection with the places you’ve already been.
